name: Session 1: The Bridge of Saints
description:
The first session, run from [[plan/taster|the Run Plan]], with the players rolling their own characters ([[plan/taster-1b-characters|1b]]).

- **The characters.** Backgrounds rolled at the table on the d20. Greg Sayers also rolled his first background table (a 5: The Cathedral and the Canopy); there was no time for the others' background tables, or anyone's traits, bonds or omens: [[pc/oswald|Oswald Cloch Crochta]] (Barber-Surgeon, with [[creature/oswalds-donkey|his donkey]]), [[pc/siofra|Siofra]] (Outrider, a 17 on the d20, riding [[creature/lasarine|Lasarine]]), [[pc/blindy|Blindy]] (Mountebank, a 16) and [[pc/greg-sayers|Greg Sayers]] (Scrivener). Each had a copy of [[document/marcos-letter|Marcos's letter]] and [[document/marcos-map|map]] from [[event/reading-of-the-will|the reading of the will]].
- **The road.** From [[place/the-fork|the Fork]] the party took the old road, straight for the [[place/bridge-of-saints|Bridge of Saints]]. Siofra rode on ahead, north into the distance ([[event/siofra-rides-north|Siofra rides on north]]).
- **The bridge.** The ruined village by the bridge lay under mist, suspiciously empty. A goblin turned up in the middle of it, and the party offered it food. More goblins came and began to threaten them, until Blindy, on a passed WIL save, made them believe that [[npc/goblob|Goblob]], their god carved over the statue of [[npc/st-rylan|St. Rylan]], had sent word of food further down the river. They all ran off to get it ([[event/goblins-sent-downriver|The goblins are sent downriver]]). No fight, and nothing lost. By the end of the session, Oswald's donkey was pulling Blindy's cart.

From the Warden's recap, recorded that evening, and the players' notes. The characters' ties to Marcos, and Oswald's and Greg Sayers's sheets, were added afterwards. Part of the recording, where the party introduce themselves, is inaudible: anything said there is missing.
left_off: At the Bridge of Saints, on the evening of day 2 by [[plan/taster-clock|the clock]] (one leg from the Fork, no wrong turns). Oswald, Blindy and Greg Sayers are in the emptied goblin camp, with everything they carried; Siofra is alone somewhere up the old road towards the [[place/rising-sun-tavern|Rising Sun]].
threads:
- **The goblins** will find nothing downriver. Whether they come back, and how they feel about it, is yours to decide; a Reactions roll when they do.
- **Siofra** is alone on the road to the Rising Sun, where a voice in the cellar ([[creature/the-thing|the Thing]]) would be glad of company. The party is split: run each part as its own scene.
- **The statue's staff** ([[relic/statue-staff|a Stone Torch of St. Rylan]]) is still on the statue, and the camp is unguarded.
- **The clock:** 10 of about 13 travel watches remain before the doors open on day 8 ([[event/autumn-equinox|the equinox]]); the two legs to the wall take 6.
- **Before play next time, finish the characters (about 5 minutes).** The sheets are short of what [[rule/character-creation|Character Creation]] asks; each player rolls their own:
  - **Everyone:** the eight [[rule/character-creation-character-traits-d10|traits]] (a d10 each), a [[rolltable/character-creation-bonds-table|Bond]], and their age (2d20+10). The youngest then rolls an [[rolltable/character-creation-omens-table|Omen]] and reads it aloud.
  - **Oswald:** both Barber-Surgeon tables, [[rolltable/barber-surgeon-table-1|How have you "improved" yourself?]] and [[rolltable/barber-surgeon-table-2|What rare tool is essential to your work?]].
  - **Siofra:** both Outrider tables, [[rolltable/outrider-table-1|What personal code or principle do you uphold?]] (her sheet's "mercenary" note may guide it) and [[rolltable/outrider-table-2|What breed is your horse?]], for Lasarine.
  - **Blindy:** both Mountebank tables, [[rolltable/mountebank-table-1|How was your fraud exposed?]] and [[rolltable/mountebank-table-2|What keepsake could always identify you?]].
  - **Greg Sayers:** the Scrivener's second, [[rolltable/scrivener-table-2|How do you transcribe sensitive information?]]; his first is The Cathedral and the Canopy.
  - **Knock-on results:** an Outrider 6 rolls a second Bond; a Mountebank 3 rolls an Omen and keeps it secret; an Outrider 1, or a Barber-Surgeon 5 on the first table, adds 1 Armour (no more than 3). Then record it all here.
- **Still to record:** the donkey's name, and how much Siofra learned of Marcos's work.
- **Secrets at the table:** how Blindy got the map is hers alone; Greg Sayers knows the spheres from a book the others have not read.

name: Session 2: The Temple of St. Rylan
description:
The second and last session, an hour long, run from [[plan/s2|the Run Plan]]. Three characters: [[pc/oswald|Oswald Cloch Crochta]], [[pc/siofra|Siofra]] and [[pc/greg-sayers|Greg Sayers]]. [[pc/blindy|Blindy]]'s player has left the table: overnight at the bridge the goblins take Blindy, and she stays in the story, for any player whose character dies to take over.

Its shape, along the old road north from where [[session/session-1|Session 1]] ended:

1. **The goblins come back** (day 3, dawn, at the [[place/bridge-of-saints|Bridge of Saints]]). The [[creature/bridge-goblins|band]] found no food downriver, and has Blindy gagged in her own cart. One confrontation: the goblins talked round (and perhaps following the party, in [[npc/goblob|Goblob]]'s name), let go, or fought.
2. **The Rising Sun** (days 3 and 4). Siofra, a day ahead, spends a night alone at the ruined [[place/rising-sun-tavern|Rising Sun]], by a barred cellar door and a voice that offers treasure for its freedom ([[creature/the-thing|the Thing in the Tavern]]). The others arrive the next midday.
3. **To the wall, and the wait** (days 4 to 7). The last leg of the [[route/road-tavern-gatehouse|old road]] to the [[place/porcelain-wall|Porcelain Wall]], under its [[creature/wall-sentries|sentries]], and the days below it until the doors open.
4. **The gatehouse** (day 8, before dawn). Through the [[place/porcelain-gatehouse|Porcelain Gatehouse]] as the guard changes.
5. **The temple** (day 8, [[event/autumn-equinox|the Autumn Equinox]]). The iron doors of the [[place/temple-of-st-rylan|Temple of St. Rylan]] open at dawn: the mosaic of the saint's life, seven pedestals and five [[itemtype/silver-sphere|silver spheres]] ([[relic/green-sphere|green]], [[relic/blue-sphere|blue]], [[relic/black-sphere|black]], [[relic/purple-sphere|purple]] and [[relic/pink-sphere|pink]]), [[document/priests-plea|the Last Priest's Plea]], and [[document/hann-note|Hann's note]] where two are missing. What the party takes, and what comes for them on the way out.
6. **Epilogue** (Bith na Bró). What each character did with what they took, and where it ended; then what became of the spheres ([[event/spheres-scattered|the Seven Spheres are scattered]]), ending on [[document/the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

What happened in each part is recorded after play.
threads:
- **Run it from** [[plan/s2|the Run Plan]], with [[plan/s2-crib|the one-page crib]] and [[plan/s2-crib-rolls|every roll]]. At 0:30, if the party is not at the wall, cut to the temple doors.
- **After play, record:** the date; each part's outcome; the goblins' and Blindy's fate; whether the Thing was freed; which spheres went where, and with whom; any deaths, and who took Blindy over. Then widen the party's Session 2 reveals (access/grants.csv, `group:session-2`) to anything else they saw: the side chambers' finds, the dryad.
